title: eludite.git.discard input
description: Undo Changes (Git Changes and the Workspace window's context menu; the UI asks first, as Visual Studio does): the working-tree files go back to the index's content, and untracked files are deleted. With `staged`, the index entries go back to HEAD's first, so the files return to HEAD. The changes are lost: class dangerous. The repository is the one discovered from the open workspace (solution folder or opened folder) upward, as `git` discovers it; without one the command fails naming eludite.git.init.

paths.description: Paths relative to the repository root, or absolute paths inside its working tree.

staged.description: Discard staged changes too (back to HEAD). Default false.
